source.title: Final Term Examination 2017-2018, Std. VII, Geography
source.subject: geography
source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Typeset paper rendered as images with no usable text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. No school name is printed. The paper prints 'Final Term Examination 2017-2018'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed academic year (the file name also ends 2018). Time is printed as '2Hrs.+15mins.' (135 minutes). Q2 [10] has 8 items with 10 blanks and is kept as one entry; Q3 [5], Q4 [6], Q5 [1/2x12=6], Q7 [2x4=8] and Q8 [3x10=30] are split with item marks from the printed group marks; Q6 parts carry printed marks. Listed marks total 80. Most of the paper is on South America and on the Earth's motions, which have no matching chapter in the class 7 list, so those questions have chapter null; only Q8(b) (factors affecting climate) is mapped to weather-and-climate. Spelling is kept as printed (e.g. 'Tilecaca', 'Magellon', 'maintains', 'plantatons', 'Tiera de Fuago', 'depeleting'). The icseboard.org watermark is ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
